title: Utility Services Program Rate Schedule: Block Pricing of Final Water Overage by Overage Record
content:
# Block Pricing of the Final Water Overage — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

The final water overage of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account is priced in blocks according to the account's water overage record — the water overage lines issued on the account fewer than twelve whole months before the billing date:

| Water overage lines in the twelve months | Priced water overage |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | the first 1.000 thousand gallons as measured, and the rest at 1.25 times |
| 1 or 2 | the whole final water overage at 1.10 times |
| none | the final water overage as measured |

The priced water overage is rounded to 3 decimals, and it is the quantity the line's charge is priced on. The line still records the final water overage itself as its usage.

## Priced overage for sample overages (hypothetical)

| Final water overage | 3 or more prior lines | 1 or 2 prior lines | none |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1.760 | 1.000 plus 0.950 (0.760 at 1.25) is 1.950 | 1.936 | 1.760 |
| 0.800 | 0.800 (all within the first block) | 0.880 | 0.800 |
| 3.000 | 1.000 plus 2.500 is 3.500 | 3.300 | 3.000 |
